Babel is part of 7 of my public repositories, from 2016 to 2025.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (4), [Libraries](@/projects/libraries.md) (2) and [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1).

Most recently: [microcrawler-browser](@/work/microcrawler-browser.md): Proof-of-Concept: Microcrawler in your Browser!; [microcrawler-js](@/work/microcrawler-js.md): Scrapping made easy; [bcnode-old](@/work/bcnode-old.md): Mining node with built-in block rover and DHT.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Babel: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Babel to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
